# Maryland Business Online

Maryland Business Online is a statewide directory for discovering local businesses, county hubs, resources, and community information across Maryland.

## Key Links

- [Homepage](https://marylandbusiness.online/)
- [Sitemap](https://marylandbusiness.online/sitemap-index.xml)
- [Resources](https://marylandbusiness.online/resources)
- [About](https://marylandbusiness.online/about)
- [Directory data API](https://marylandbusiness.online/api/directory.json)

## Notes for AI Agents

- Use the sitemap for crawl discovery.
- Business listing and directory hub pages are canonical public pages.
- Prefer the public pages over inferred or generated URLs.
